competitiveTarget: Zillow Showcase + Hilton & Hyland editorial register (per docs/research/top-brokerage-listing-content-audit.md)

requiredComponents.name: ListingHero
requiredComponents.section: ld-photo-grid full-bleed hero (5-photo grid, 520px height, 'View all N photos' overlay). Auto-plays muted listing video when getListingVideos returns one — falls back to photo grid otherwise.
requiredComponents.notes: Supersedes both PhotoGallery and ListingVideoEmbed. Video-at-hero is the Zillow Showcase parity feature; the mockup shows a photo-grid hero; the component picks the right surface based on data.

requiredComponents.name: PriceCtaStrip
requiredComponents.section: ld-price-block — price + address + city·subdivision + 3-pill row (Active · DOM · $/sqft) + 4-button CTA row (Schedule a tour · Ask a question · Save · Share)
requiredComponents.notes: Supersedes PriceBlock. Save + Share state persists to saved_listings + likes tables. Schedule + Ask route to /contact?listingKey=<key> pre-tagged.

requiredComponents.name: PropertySpecs
requiredComponents.section: ld-section: Key facts grid — beds, baths, sqft, lot, year built, garage, HOA, property tax, property type, heating, cooling, MLS#

requiredComponents.name: DescriptionBlock
requiredComponents.section: ld-section: About this home — public_remarks paragraphed, 68ch column, brand-voice clean

requiredComponents.name: NeighborhoodMarketContext
requiredComponents.section: nbhd-context (THE ZILLOW BEATER) — live market stats for THIS subdivision/neighborhood: active count, median list, median DOM, months of supply + 'This home is listed at $X · Y% above the median'. Data source: getMarketStats('neighborhood', slug) + getMarketPulse
requiredComponents.notes: Per Plan §8 'What we BEAT' rank 1. No competitor surfaces this. This is the differentiator.

requiredComponents.name: SchoolsBlock
requiredComponents.section: ld-section: Schools — elementary, middle, high stat cards with school district
requiredComponents.notes: Per Plan §8 Zillow Showcase parity — schools is table stakes.

requiredComponents.name: MortgageCalculator
requiredComponents.section: ld-section: Estimated monthly payment — mortgage-calc dual column (inputs + PITI summary panel)

requiredComponents.name: PropertyHistory
requiredComponents.section: ld-section: Property history — timeline of listed/sold/price-change events from listing_history

requiredComponents.name: ListingLocationMap
requiredComponents.section: ld-section: Location — 21:9 map with subdivision boundary + POI overlay + lifestyle line (minutes to Mt. Bachelor / downtown / trail)
requiredComponents.notes: Per Plan §8 'What we BEAT' rank 6 — Bend lifestyle data.

requiredComponents.name: KbFeatured
requiredComponents.section: Similar homes — the canonical full-width featured-homes rail (same as the city/community pages), scoped to THIS listing's subdivision/neighborhood (city fallback) via resolveFeaturedItems. Supersedes the old SimilarListings 4-card MV grid + the VideoHomesSection cross-sell (Matt directive 2026-06-24).
requiredComponents.notes: Renders below the main+sidebar grid, full-bleed. Excludes the current listing. resolveFeaturedItems builds the KbFeaturedItem[] from getListingTiles({subdivision|neighborhood|city, status:'active'}).

requiredComponents.name: ListingDetailShell
requiredComponents.section: page chrome — main+sticky-sidebar grid + JSON-LD (no visual breadcrumb; BreadcrumbList JSON-LD retained for SEO, Matt directive 2026-06-24)

requiredComponents.name: TextMattCTA
requiredComponents.section: ld-side sticky: text-matt block — broker contact card with phone + Schedule a tour + Text Matt
requiredComponents.notes: Per Plan §8 'What we BEAT' rank 2 — sticky 'Text Matt: 541.213.6706' CTA.

requiredComponents.name: ListingAgentCard
requiredComponents.section: ld-side: Listing agent compact card (transparent PNG headshot)

requiredComponents.name: PhotoGalleryLightbox
requiredComponents.section: fullscreen lightbox primitive consumed by ListingHero (D75 — thumbnails + dots + swipe + counter)
requiredComponents.notes: Lifted out of ListingHero per DESIGN_DIRECTIVES.md D75 so every gallery surface inherits the same nav contract. Page does NOT import directly — ListingHero does.

requiredComponents.name: ClimateRiskBlock
requiredComponents.section: Climate risk grid — flood / wildfire / heat / drought 1-10 cards + source line (D77 Zillow Showcase parity)
requiredComponents.notes: Page passes `risk={null}` when no FEMA/WUI/NOAA data has been resolved for the parcel. Component renders a 'Get the climate report' CTA in that case — never a fake number per CLAUDE.md §0.

requiredComponents.name: VacationRentalPotential
requiredComponents.section: Resort-community STR projection — peak/off-peak nightly + occupancy + annual gross (D77)
requiredComponents.notes: Page passes a real projection only when the listing's community is in the STR-allowed resort set (Tetherow, Sunriver, Eagle Crest, etc.) AND comp data is available. Otherwise `projection={null}` and the component renders a CTA.

requiredComponents.name: TransparentCMASummary
requiredComponents.section: When Ryan Realty has run a CMA on this listing, show the range + suggested + comp count + PDF link (D77)
requiredComponents.notes: Component returns null when `cma={null}` — page queries public.cmas for the listing_key. This is the 'show our work' differentiator vs Zillow Showcase.
